title: Blending in a section and the role of the lead
summary: Sections blend if players balance volume; only the lead should stand out slightly.

blocks.x: True. Encounters with things like bands -- playing -- in bands playing in sections -- when the instruments were not matched -- I mean you see that they look
different or something -- you know maybe one guy's playing the cornet and another one has long horn or trumpet and so on, was that harder in the past than it is now?
To get a good blend in a section and stuff.
Was it harder what? You mean within --
You mean did we -- did the band blend?
They blended if the guys played it right. Sure they blended. They blended just fine. If the guy was playing them right.

Some guys blow their horn and make it too loud for this other horn, you know. And they're all supposed to blend together and make it all come out with the same volume. That's what you want. The right volume of each instrument so that each can be heard. Not that you overshadow this other instrument.
Yeah. The only thing that's supposed to stand out a little louder than any of them is the lead. He's got to stand out just a little louder than the others. But not too much louder.
Because if he blasts, the other guys gotta blast you know.
